note:
身份: 曾在村庄宣传莲花环礁更新的 NPC；姓名 Lotus Atoll 保留英文，对白中的同名地名则沿用莲花环礁。
关系: 向刚搭话的玩家分享见闻，并指路。
说话方式: 轻松口语，先铺垫，再兴奋地揭晓发现。
性格与词汇: 好奇、热情；青蛙、岛屿、亲眼看看。
禁用风格: 不写宣传稿或中二宣言，不硬塞网络梗，不补出航行门槛或任务机制。
颜色证据: 本次 Playwright 社区 Wiki 呈现页面的 DOM 颜色还原样本，非服务器原始字节。
wiki_last_edited: This page was last edited on 4 August 2026, at 17:13.

entries.context: 无条件对白；以青蛙主题的闲逛玩笑开场。
entries.text: I've been frogging around all this time...
entries.raw: §fI've been frogging around all this time...
entries.gloss: frogging around 是青蛙主题的口语玩笑；保留闲逛与青蛙的意象，不补出钓取、交付或任务机制。
entries.zh: 我一直在四处闲逛，跟青蛙打交道……

entries.context: 无条件对白；兴奋地提起昨天见到的特别岛屿。
entries.text: But yesterday, I saw something amazing! An island the likes of which I had never seen before!
entries.raw: §fBut yesterday, I saw something amazing! An island the likes of which I had never seen before!
entries.gloss: the likes of which I had never seen before 指从未见过那样的岛，不仅是第一次见到这座岛。
entries.zh: 不过昨天，我可真开了眼! 那样的岛，我以前从没见过!

entries.context: 无条件对白；揭晓所见岛屿的名字。
entries.gloss: 此处 Lotus Atoll 是地名而非说话人的姓名；沿用 original_text/_shared/Terms.json 的 Lotus Atoll → 莲花环礁。

entries.context: 无条件对白；介绍岛上丰富的莲花海洋生物和锦标蛙。
entries.text: It was brimming with Lotus Sea Creatures and Trophy Frogs galore!
entries.raw: §fIt was brimming with §3Lotus Sea Creatures §fand §2Trophy Frogs §fgalore!
entries.gloss: Lotus Sea Creatures 沿用本地 GUI 整名 original_text/Fishing/GUI_Item/Sea_Creature_Guide.json#scg_region_lotus → 莲花海洋生物；Trophy Frogs 沿用 original_text/Mining/GUI_Item/Pity.json#pity_trophy_frogs 及 original_text/Hub_General/GUI_Lore/SkyBlock_Guide_Tasks.json#guide_task_trophy_frogs → 锦标蛙。两者是生物类别，非 NPC 要求交付的物品。
entries.zh: 岛上满是莲花海洋生物和锦标蛙，多得不得了!

entries.context: 无条件对白；邀请玩家去亲眼看看，并指路到钓鱼前哨找船长 Baha。
entries.text: If you want to see it for yourself, go and find Captain Baha in the Fishing Outpost!
entries.raw: §fIf you want to see it for yourself, go and find §6Captain Baha §fin the §bFishing Outpost§f!
entries.gloss: Captain Baha 沿用 original_text/Hub_General/GUI_Item/SkyBlock_Guide_Item_Names.json#guide_item_captain_baha 及 original_text/Fishing/Hologram/Roles_September.json#round_tail_captain_baha → 船长 Baha，只翻职务、不翻人名。Fishing Outpost 沿用 original_text/_shared/Terms.json → 钓鱼前哨。中文将地点置于找人之前；所有分段保留英文原序并完整标注 order。
entries.zh: 想亲眼去看看，就去钓鱼前哨找船长 Baha 吧!
